data.one_liner: A simple Flutter package for capturing still pictures using a dialog interface.
data.what_it_does: It provides a simple camera dialog interface to capture still pictures using the device camera. It supports iOS, Android, and web platforms and returns the captured picture as an XFile.
use_when: You need a quick dialog-based camera interface to take a single picture.
You want to easily integrate camera functionality into iOS, Android, and web apps.
avoid_when: You need complex video recording capabilities.
You need deep customization of the camera UI beyond a simple dialog.
strengths: Simple function call to trigger the camera dialog.
Cross-platform support including iOS, Android, and the web.
weaknesses: Limited to taking still pictures via a dialog interface.
Lacks advanced camera controls and custom UI layouts.
data.setup_notes: Relies on the camera plugin; ensure standard camera permissions are configured for native platforms.

alternatives.name: camera
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides full low-level control over the camera stream and custom UI implementation.
